description: Base (EVM) token and contract risk screen: honeypot, transfer taxes, verified source, backdoors and liquidity lock. When to use: before an agent trades, quotes or accepts a token on Base, or when an address shows up in an AgentKit / onchain-agent flow and you need the hard facts first - can it be sold, what does the exit cost, who can change the rules. Do not use: for Solana mints (that is sol_check_token_safety) or for TRON addresses (tron_check_address_risk); it does not simulate a live sell. Returns: risk_level (low|medium|high), safety_score, is_honeypot, cannot_sell_all, buy_tax_pct, sell_tax_pct, is_open_source, is_proxy, is_mintable, owner_change_balance, hidden_owner, can_take_back_ownership, transfer_pausable, selfdestruct, holder_count, top10_holder_pct, lp_locked_pct, dex pairs, warnings[], not_covered[] and a disclaimer. Metered: 5 free calls per day per IP, then 0.01 USDC per call over x402. There is no API key: the 402 answer carries the machine-readable terms in structuredContent.accepts[].
